definitions.explanation: A room designated for independent study, found in schools, libraries, cram schools, and coworking spaces. In Japan, study rooms are common at libraries and juku (cram schools), and paid study spaces have become increasingly popular.

examples.japanese: {自習室|じしゅうしつ}で{勉強|べんきょう}する。
examples.english: I study in the study room.

examples.japanese: {図書館|としょかん}の{自習室|じしゅうしつ}は{静|しず}かで{集中|しゅうちゅう}できる。
examples.english: The library study room is quiet and I can concentrate.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}{前|まえ}は{自習室|じしゅうしつ}がいつも{満席|まんせき}になるので、{早|はや}めに{席|せき}を{確保|かくほ}したほうがいい。
examples.english: The study room always fills up before exams, so you should secure a seat early.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {自習|じしゅう} (self-study) + {室|しつ} (room). Common in school and library settings. In recent years, {有料|ゆうりょう}{自習室|じしゅうしつ} (paid study rooms) have become popular in Japanese cities as quiet workspaces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自習室|じしゅうしつ}を{利用|りよう}する (to use a study room)
- {自習室|じしゅうしつ}が{満席|まんせき} (the study room is full)
- {有料|ゆうりょう}{自習室|じしゅうしつ} (paid study room)
- {自習室|じしゅうしつ}で{勉強|べんきょう}する (to study in a study room)
